description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@10) achieved by different Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference, labeled as 'S' on the x-axis. The x-axis ranges from 2 to 10, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2, representing the number of queries used. The y-axis, labeled 'MRR@10', ranges from 33.0 to 36.5 and uses a linear scale, measuring retrieval performance. The plot displays six distinct lines, each corresponding to a different DPR configuration: 'DPR w/o query' (black solid line), 'DPR w/ gold' (yellow-green dashed line with circular markers), 'DPR w/ top-1' (dark green solid line with circular markers), 'DPR w/ bottom-1' (purple dashed line with circular markers), 'DPR w/ random' (blue dashed line with circular markers), and 'DPR w/ curriculum' (red dashed line with circular markers). The 'DPR w/o query' line starts at approximately 33.0 and remains constant throughout. The 'DPR w/ gold' line begins at approximately 33.0 and increases steadily to about 35.0 by the end. The 'DPR w/ top-1' line starts near 33.0, rises sharply to about 36.3 at S=4, and then plateaus near 36.5 from S=6 onwards. The 'DPR w/ bottom-1' line begins at approximately 34.5 and remains relatively flat around 34.5–34.8. The 'DPR w/ random' line starts near 34.8 and stays roughly constant around 35.2. The 'DPR w/ curriculum' line starts at approximately 35.2, rises slightly to about 35.8, and then plateaus near 35.8–35.9.
